long_horizon_goal: Prepare the patient room for a new admission by organizing furniture and ensuring a sanitized environment.

step_by_step_procedures.sub_goal: The agent is positioned within manipulative range of the bed.
The base sheet is taut and covering the mattress surface entirely.
The pillow is centered at the head of the bed.
The blanket is neatly aligned or folded at the foot of the bed.
The IV pole is secured in its designated standby position.
The chair is moved against the wall to clear the walking path.
The floor area is disinfected and free of debris.
